result.rationale: The diff changes EventManager to set externalCalendarId from `result.externalId` instead of `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`. In createAllCalendarEvents' no-credentialId branch, `createEvent(c, event)` is called without the third externalId argument (the new `externalId` param defaults to undefined), so the EventResult.externalId is undefined and the stored booking reference loses the externalCalendarId that the old code preserved. This is verifiable directly in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents(), when iterating destinations, the branch where `destination.credentialId` is falsy calls `createEvent(c, event)` without passing `destination.externalId` (diff around `createdEvents = createdEvents.concat(await Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event))))`). CalendarManager.createEvent() now returns `externalId` based only on the optional argument, and EventManager later persists `externalCalendarId: result.externalId` (replacing the prior `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`). Therefore, for destinations without a credentialId, `result.externalId` will be undefined and the stored booking reference loses the externalCalendarId even though the destination has an externalId available.
